```{python}
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from scripts.helpers import load, load_one, render_news, _md
from IPython.display import HTML, display

profile = load_one('profile.yaml')
news    = load('news.yaml')

# ── Profile block ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
interests_html = "".join(f"<li>{i}</li>" for i in (profile.get('research_interests') or []))

links_html = ""
if profile.get('email'):
    links_html += f'<a href="mailto:{profile["email"]}">{profile["email"]}</a><br>'
if profile.get('google_scholar'):
    links_html += f'<a href="{profile["google_scholar"]}">Google Scholar</a> &nbsp;'
if profile.get('github'):
    links_html += f'<a href="https://github.com/{profile["github"]}">GitHub</a> &nbsp;'
if profile.get('orcid'):
    links_html += f'<a href="https://orcid.org/{profile["orcid"]}">ORCID</a>'
if profile.get('cv_pdf'):
    links_html += f' &nbsp;<a href="{profile["cv_pdf"]}">CV (PDF)</a>'

import os
photo_path = 'assets/photo.jpg'
if os.path.exists(photo_path):
    photo_html = '<img src="assets/photo.jpg" alt="Profile photo" style="width:180px;border-radius:6px">'
else:
    photo_html = (
        '<div style="width:180px;height:220px;background:#e8f0f8;border-radius:6px;'
        'display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;'
        'color:#2c5f8a;font-size:0.8em;text-align:center;padding:1rem">'
        'Add photo to<br><code>assets/photo.jpg</code></div>'
    )

display(HTML(f"""
<div class="profile-block">
  <div style="flex-shrink:0">{photo_html}</div>
  <div>
    <h1 style="margin-top:0">{profile.get('name','')}</h1>
    <p style="color:var(--text-muted);margin:0">
      {profile.get('position','')} &nbsp;·&nbsp; {profile.get('institution','')}
    </p>
    <p style="margin:0.5rem 0 1rem">{links_html}</p>
    <div style="margin-bottom:1rem">{_md(profile.get('bio',''))}</div>
    {('<div><strong>Research interests</strong><ul style="margin:0.25rem 0 0">' + interests_html + '</ul></div>') if interests_html else ''}
  </div>
</div>
"""))

# ── News ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if news:
    display(HTML(
        '<h2 class="section-heading">News</h2>'
        + render_news(news)
    ))
```
